name: A Court of Chaos
source:
The Queen is cruel. The court is corrupt. And the goblin in the dungeon? He’s about to flip the castle upside-down.

A Court of Chaos is a short, adult visual novel that trades sprawling storylines for pure, escalating humiliation. Play as Briggs, a lowly goblin with a grudge, who teams up with the queen's bitter court to unravel the Queen’s dignity — one prank, hex, and "wardrobe malfunction" at a time.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3740830/Court_of_Chaos/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
女王很残忍。法院很腐败。那么地牢里的妖精呢？他要把城堡翻个底朝天。

《混沌法庭》是一部简短的成人视觉小说，用庞大的故事情节换取了纯粹的、不断升级的羞辱。扮演布里格斯，一个心怀怨恨的卑微妖精，与女王的痛苦宫廷合作，瓦解女王的尊严——一次一个恶作剧、咒语和“衣柜故障”。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3740830/Court_of_Chaos/]Steam[/url]]
